image_prompt.text: An enclosed rectangular paintball field of roughly 200x100 studs, walled in by solid outer boundary walls on all four sides

Waist-high and full-body paintball barriers in bright, playful colours distributed evenly across the field and mirrored between the two halves, from large blocks down to small scattered cover elements
The gaps at either end of the large central dividing barrier, pinching cross-field traffic into contested ground in the middle of the arena
Elevated sniper platforms overlooking the field, reachable only by exposed ramps, one mirrored on each half
Mirrored team bases at the two short ends of the field, shielded from sniper lines down the arena

layout_placement.text: Two balanced team spawns at opposite ends of the arena, identical to each other for fair team play

notes: Preset Team Deathmatch taken with open-battlefield substituted for the preset's lane-network shape: the prompt describes one enclosed symmetrical field of dispersed cover, not parallel lanes. Its options are kept.
choke-bottleneck kept from the preset and read onto the central dividing barrier, whose ends are the only crossings between halves.
cover-elevated routes P0 + tiered: the platforms are reached by ramps and nothing in the prompt overhangs the floor below, so no P2.
Stated size 'roughly 200x100 studs' is carried in the boundary-wall text because the scale band cannot hold an exact figure.
The prompt says 'based on the reference image' but no image was supplied with it; the arena was built from the written description alone.

would have asked: Sounds like a symmetrical team deathmatch field - mirrored team spawns at the two short ends, colourful barriers spread evenly over both halves, pinch points at each end of the central divider, and ramped sniper platforms, all inside one walled rectangular arena rather than three lanes. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?
would have asked: confirm the sniper platforms sit on solid raised structures rather than overhanging the field beneath them - solid keeps this on the proven tiered build.
would have asked: anything else you want in the space?
